mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% signals an aggressive monetary easing policy that reduces the cost of capital and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is at or below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% indicates significant labor market deterioration, triggering risk-off sentiment and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) signal a broad-based economic contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and INDPRO decline by more than 2% from their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of low inflation (CPIAUCSL below 2.0%) and low interest rates (FEDFUNDS below 1.0%), the Federal Reserve is expected to maintain accommodative policy, supporting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low inflation and low rates (CPIAUCSL < 2.0% and FEDFUNDS < 1.0%)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is below 2.0% and FEDFUNDS is below 1.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeding 100,000 persons signals weakening labor market conditions, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS declines by more than 100,000.

mechanism_narrative: Higher residential sales (RSAFS) indicate stronger consumer spending and economic activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not positively correlated with RSAFS (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 1.5% from its 3-month moving average signals a manufacturing slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO declines by more than 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Higher industrial production (INDPRO) indicates stronger manufacturing activity, supporting corporate earnings and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not positively correlated with INDPRO (Rank IC < 0.03) over any 3-year rolling window.
